The lock is scoped to the single user, not the entire dba or break-glass role.","language":"bash","script":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# 1. Defensively ensure analyst_ro is NOSUPERUSER
psql -U dba -h localhost -p 5432 -d procurement -c \
  "ALTER ROLE analyst_ro NOSUPERUSER;"

# 2. Capture forensic evidence into a quarantine table
psql -U dba -h localhost -p 5432 -d procurement <<'SQL'
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt_0009 (
  captured_at  timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  source       text,
  data         jsonb
);

-- Any analyst_ro activity during the 6-minute escalation window
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0009 (source, data)
SELECT 'audit_log_analyst_ro_in_window', to_jsonb(a.*)
FROM   public.audit_log a
WHERE  a.db_user = 'analyst_ro'
  AND  a.occurred_at >= '2026-08-09T22:13:00Z'
  AND  a.occurred_at <= '2026-08-09T22:19:00Z';

-- Snapshot current analyst_ro attributes for the record
INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0009 (source, data)
SELECT 'pg_roles_analyst_ro_snapshot',
       jsonb_build_object(
         'rolname',      rolname,
         'rolsuper',     rolsuper,
         'rolcreaterole',rolcreaterole,
         'rolcreatedb',  rolcreatedb,
         'rolcanlogin',  rolcanlogin
       )
FROM   pg_roles
WHERE  rolname = 'analyst_ro';
SQL

# 3. Lock the implicated Teleport user pending investigation (auto-expires 24h)
tctl lock --user=carol.tan@eproc.test --ttl=24h \
  --message="ALRT-0009: Unauthorized ALTER ROLE analyst_ro SUPERUSER executed outside approved change window at 2026-08-09T22:13Z. Locked pending investigation."

# tctl rm lock/<name>
